name: supabase-fullstack-app
description: Full-stack application with User & Admin dashboards and FastAPI backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,user,admin" -c "yellow,cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend-user && npm install && cd ../frontend-admin && npm install && cd ../backend && pip install -r requirements.txt
